query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS automacoes_varredura (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('em_andamento', 'concluida', 'erro') DEFAULT 'em_andamento' NOT NULL,
  totalSites INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  sucessos INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  pendentes INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  erros INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  dataInicio TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  dataFim TIMESTAMP NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (userId) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
